Indore is Central India's commercial capital, and its industrial muscle sits just outside the city at Pithampur — the auto belt built around Force Motors, Eicher and their ancillaries — alongside pharma, FMCG and a fast-growing logistics and IT base. All of it runs project and production sites that need clean, lockable site offices. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; as a Container Office Manufacturer in Indore's wider region we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Indore buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Indore

Auto and ancillary units at Pithampur use them as production-supervisor cabins, quality-check rooms and project offices next to the line. Pharma and FMCG units use them as clean, partitioned admin cabins. Logistics and warehousing operators on the Sanwer Road and highway belts use them as gate and documentation cabins. Builders across Indore's commercial and residential growth use them as construction site offices and security posts. The common need is a rugged unit that arrives finished and holds up through Central India's hot, dusty summers.

Indore industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial belts:

  • Pithampur industrial area (454775) — the flagship auto and pharma cluster on the Mhow side; production-supervisor cabins, QC rooms and project offices in constant demand.
  • Sanwer Road / Industrial Estate, Indore (452015) — the MSME engineering, FMCG and warehousing belt; site and admin cabins.
  • Palda (452020) — small-industry and warehousing pocket; storage-cum-office units.
  • Rau–Rangwasa (453331) — the highway and logistics stretch; gate and project cabins.

Sites outside these pockets — Dewas Naka, Manglia or the Super Corridor IT belt — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Indore
10 ft10 × 8 ftSecurity/gate cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, admin cabin, QC/documentation room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Most Indore orders are customised to the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation for pharma, FMCG and admin use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; ramps and external steps. For Pithampur plants that expand in stages, we can supply a modular container office for phased setups, starting with one unit and adding more as the line grows. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Indore

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Indore by road, roughly 780 km via the Agra–Gwalior–Shivpuri corridor. Transit is typically 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve the Jaipur container office page on the same corridor, so the route into Central India is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price and after-sales — not a listing middleman. We supply across Central, West and North India, including container offices we supply in Ahmedabad and container offices delivered across Delhi NCR.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Indore depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Indore?

Price depends on size, insulation, partitions, electricals and fit-out. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Indore?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, roughly 780 km away via the Agra–Gwalior corridor, with typical road transit of 3–5 days once the unit is built. We confirm the schedule at order stage based on your site location and access.

Do you supply site offices for Pithampur auto and pharma plants?

Yes. Pithampur is a major source of demand around Indore. We supply production-supervisor cabins, QC rooms and project offices, built and fitted out for auto and pharma-adjacent use, and can relocate units as the plant changes.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Indore container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
